text:
Palladium Price in 2003
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2003, the LBMA palladium price fell 23.8% between 2003-01-31 ($256) and 2003-12-30 ($195). The highest sampled price was $256 in January and the lowest was $154 in April. The mean of these observations was $198. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
